# Skill 75 per-file pytest gate -- files ALLOWED to collect zero test items.
#
# Read by the step "Skill 75 pytest collection + run (no hidden failures)" in
# .github/workflows/qc-static.yml. pytest exits 5 for "no tests collected".
# Exit 5 is tolerated ONLY for a path listed here; every other test_*.py /
# *_test.py under 75-drama-song-ad-factory/scripts that collects nothing now
# FAILS the build.
#
# Why exit 5 used to be free for every file: commit 83121e15c ("CI speed:
# single-pass Skill 75 suite, deflake 2 tests, fix compact-core", 2026-11-02)
# split the whole-tree run into one pytest process per file. Per file, a suite
# with no pytest items returns 5, where the old single-process run returned 0
# because OTHER files had items. 5 was whitelisted to keep that parity, not
# because an empty test file is acceptable. The parity it bought was silence:
# a file could be named like a test, sit in a test directory, collect zero
# items forever, and the gate stayed green (U-GEN434 found the shape, U-GEN435
# measured it: 42 files under scripts/).
#
# DO NOT ADD A PATH HERE TO SILENCE A FAILURE. Exit 5 means "collected
# nothing", so a file with a real failing test can never be listed: it exits
# non-zero for a different reason and still fails.
#
# [A] Self-running suites. The file calls pytest.skip(allow_module_level=True)
#     on purpose, with the reason in its own docstring; its assertions run
#     under `python3 <file>`, which the "Skill 75 empty-home test suite" step
#     already executes. Legitimate by design. Keep these.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
75-drama-song-ad-factory/scripts/core/singing_detector/test_receipt_evidence_g5.py
75-drama-song-ad-factory/scripts/core/singing_detector/test_singing_detector_amend_g2.py
75-drama-song-ad-factory/scripts/core/singing_detector/test_singing_detector.py
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# [B] Script-style runners with no pytest items today. Named like a test,
#     execute at import, contribute nothing to pytest's collected count. This
#     is the U-GEN434 defect, parked: converting these files is a separate
#     unit. DELETE the line as soon as its file grows pytest items, so the
#     allowlist cannot outlive its reason.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
